data.description:
Make music in VR - This is not a rhythm game!

Immerse yourself in live looping and music production in VR.

- Full support for hand tracking and mixed reality/passthrough 
- Synced looping with content library, auto time-stretched and pitch-shifted to fit the song.
- Record vocals including mo-cap and replay of your avatar.
- Use your custom Ready Player Me avatar.
- Set of drum kits/one-shots.
- Use Decks to create a seamless mix.
- Full set of audio FX applied per clip or per scene (reverbs, chorus etc). 
- Loop record automation of audio FX parameters and synth parameters.
- Assignable 3D control of FX and synth parameters.
- Loop videos synced to the beat.
- Step sequencer - trigger any item in the world and loop record instruments/drumkits. Edit steps, swing quantize.
- Built in Analog Synth sim and Wavetable synth with >250 Sounds
- Spatial Mixing - create a binaural mix based on clip positions.
- In game camera and screen/mirror.
- Use you own USB MIDI keyboard or controller

In the full version you get:
- Built in 1.5 Gb library of loops and sounds
- Use any number of synths (up to what the system can handle)
- Use your own video and loops/samples
- Export mixes of your performance
- Lots more built in videos, VFX, Avatars and worlds.

changelog.change_log: - User audio scan folder into Tranzient
- Made original tempo editable on clips

- Seamless playback mk3
- No fades when transitioning to another clip
- Auto Fade out when transitioning to silence

- v69 Meta Fork 
- Clips can now opt out of global time-stretch and key
- Launch quantize option added to samples and loops browser
- Quest3S Support
- Better performance in complex scenes

- v69.1 SDK
- Synth global quantize option
- Reset time-stretch on switch clip out of Follow global tempo, switch time-stretch to global on turning it on
- Added arpeggiator on synths

- Launch quantize for audio loops and onehots 
- Launch quantize can be global set in the click settings, or per clip
- Can also be applied to synths and drumkits for realtime quantize effect
- Improved seamless play between audio clips when triggering next/previous clips
- Less cores used for offline timestrech
- Fixed restore play state on load session

- Fixed early out of audio recording
- Moved export all to debug window
